ListGreen fails before sorting at the test expectation for 1/3 progress. Native iOS accessibility reports 33%; the corrected test checks that percentage and exact one-of-three text, with the existing Toggle selector.

Both initial four-function simulator regressions pass, but capture inspection shows editing remains active after computed sorting. EditModeRed reproduces Done versus Edit. The native List and Edit button receive the same explicit binding; the unchanged strengthened journey passes. Final captures and qualification use this corrected source.
